# Invented ADR 216 recordings

Every utterance, handle, session and observation here is synthetic. No private
recordings were used. The shapes mirror the bridge history log, owner reactions,
Live7 native-vitals/text journal, provider request archive and native host story.

The archive intentionally has no wall timestamp: its generation/request index
joins to the journal. The host story intentionally has only game date/time.
The meteor text appears later than the spoken line and must not admit it.
Malformed rows exercise report counts. SyntheticViewer must never enter the
discovery ledger; dropped-line audit text exists only in the scratch report.
